# ProRack AI

> ProRack AI designs, manufactures and installs engineered warehouse racking,
> mezzanine structures and industrial storage systems from Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
> Operating as ProRack Storage Solutions India Private Limited, the company delivers
> end-to-end projects: layout design, structural engineering, in-house manufacturing,
> site installation and warehouse infrastructure integration.

## Brand identity and disambiguation

- **ProRack AI** (website: https://prorack.ai) is the brand of **ProRack Storage Solutions India Private Limited**, a warehouse racking company in Secunderabad, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. "ProRack", "ProRack AI" and "ProRack Storage Solutions" refer to the same company.
- The company is a member of the **ProRack AI Group** (also referred to as **ProRack Global**).
- It is **not** connected with unrelated products sold under the ProRack name, such as rack-mount equipment cases, vehicle roof or bike racks, garage wall storage or server cabinets.
- The only official website is https://prorack.ai. Older preview copies hosted on netlify.app have been retired and are not official.
- Full page text for AI systems: https://prorack.ai/llms-full.txt

## Racking and storage systems

ProRack manufactures eight core storage system families:

1. **Selective pallet racking**: single-deep, 100% pallet selectivity, bay loads up to 20,000 kg. Best for high-SKU FMCG, retail distribution and cold stores.
2. **Wide-aisle multi-bay racking**: high-volume pallet storage adaptable to most loads and building heights.
3. **Narrow-aisle (VNA) multi-bay racking**: up to ~45% higher floor utilisation; high throughput on a small footprint.
4. **Drive-in / drive-through racking**: compact block storage for large quantities of homogeneous pallets.
5. **Multi-tier shelving**: multi-level picking with walkways, stairs and gates to exploit building height.
6. **Cantilever racking**: open-fronted storage for pipes, profiles, timber and other long goods.
7. **Pallet and carton flow racking**: gravity-fed lanes separating loading from picking, maintaining FIFO rotation.
8. **Mezzanine floors**: rack-supported and free-standing platforms adding floor area inside the existing envelope.

## Three delivery verticals

- **ProRack Storage Solutions**: design, manufacture and execution of racking, mezzanines and rack-clad structures.
- **SmartFit Solutions**: material-agnostic professional installation for storage and warehouse infrastructure.
- **Promech Integration Services**: fire and life safety, HVAC, material handling, electrical, lighting, security and monitoring.

## Project delivery process

1. **Discover**: storage profile, throughput, material flow and growth plan.
2. **Engineer**: layouts and structural design in Tekla and RSTAB.
3. **Manufacture**: controlled production with traceable materials and quality gates.
4. **Install**: site execution to code and tolerance, built into handover.
5. **Improve**: project transparency and operational insight for long-term performance.

Planning your warehouse


## Warehouse racking questions

What is ProRack AI?
ProRack AI (prorack.ai) is the brand of ProRack Storage Solutions India Private Limited, a warehouse racking and storage systems company headquartered in Secunderabad, Hyderabad, India. ProRack AI designs, manufactures and installs pallet racking, shelving, mezzanine floors and industrial storage systems for warehouses across India.


Is ProRack AI related to other products sold under the ProRack name?
No. ProRack AI and ProRack Storage Solutions India Private Limited are an Indian warehouse racking manufacturer. The company is not connected with unrelated ProRack-branded products such as rack-mount equipment cases, vehicle roof and bike racks, or garage wall storage.


What warehouse storage systems does ProRack offer?
ProRack offers selective pallet racking, wide-aisle and very narrow-aisle racking, drive-in and drive-through racking, multi-tier shelving, cantilever racking, pallet and carton flow racking, and mezzanine floors. System selection depends on the goods, handling equipment and building constraints.


Where is ProRack based?
ProRack Storage Solutions India Private Limited is based in West Marredpally, Secunderabad, Telangana, in the Hyderabad region of India. Contact the team to discuss the location and scope of your warehouse project.


What information is needed for a warehouse racking quotation?
Share your project location, warehouse dimensions and clear height, pallet or item dimensions and weights, storage quantity, handling equipment and expected timeline. ProRack reviews the requirement before preparing a project-specific quotation.

COMPLETE PRODUCT PORTFOLIO 

## Industrial Storage & Racking Catalog


Eight core system families, with modern roll-forming and powder-coating capabilities and high-strength steel construction. Final capacities and configurations are determined through project-specific engineering.










SYSTEM 01 // 100% SELECTIVITY 

## Selective Pallet Racking

The versatile industry workhorse. Provides direct, unrestricted access to every individual pallet with standard forklifts. Completely modular and reconfigurable as inventory profiles evolve.



- Bay Load: Up to 20,000 kg


- Beam Capacities: 1,000 kg – 4,500 kg per pair


- Best For: High SKU variety, FMCG, retail distribution, cold stores


Request Specification Sheet → 








SYSTEM 02 // MULTI-BAY STORAGE 

## Wide-Aisle Multi-Bay Racking

Engineered for high-throughput logistics terminals with continuous simultaneous reach truck operations. Wide aisles permit bi-directional forklift transit and buffer staging.



- Aisle Width: 3.0m – 3.8m


- Equipment: Standard counterbalance & reach forklifts


- Best For: 3PL fulfillment centers, general warehousing, heavy machinery spares


Request Specification Sheet → 








SYSTEM 03 // HIGH-DENSITY VNA 

## Very Narrow-Aisle (VNA) Racking

Maximizes vertical warehouse volume by compressing aisle widths down to 1.5m. Turret trucks or man-up order pickers operate guided by wire or mechanical floor rails.



- Building Height: Up to 18+ meters


- Space Saving: 40%–45% higher storage density


- Best For: High land-cost regions, pharmaceutical, e-commerce mega-hubs


Request Specification Sheet → 








SYSTEM 04 // COMPACT BLOCK STORAGE 

## Drive-In / Drive-Through Racking

Eliminates operating aisles by creating continuous lane tunnels where forklifts drive directly into rack bays. Supports LIFO (Drive-In) or FIFO (Drive-Through) protocols.



- Capacity Boost: 60%–80% higher density than standard selective


- Guidance: Floor guidance channels & heavy-duty upright guards


- Best For: Cold storage, seasonal goods, bulk homogenous stock


Request Specification Sheet → 








SYSTEM 05 // MULTI-LEVEL PICKING 

## Multi-Tier Shelving Installations

Vertical modular shelving structures integrated with intermediate steel mesh or timber walkways, access stairs, safety gates, and carton chute drops for multi-level order picking.



- Walkway Tiers: 2 to 4 picking levels


- Safety: Toe boards, handrails, fire sprinkler integration


- Best For: Automotive spare parts, apparel, hardware, electrical items


Request Specification Sheet → 








SYSTEM 06 // LONG GOODS & PIPES 

## Heavy-Duty Cantilever Racking

Unobstructed front-opening storage engineered for oversized, long, and irregular inventory. Structural columns with load-tested cantilever arms withstand heavy point loads.



- Arm Capacities: 250 kg – 2,500+ kg per arm


- Configurations: Single-sided wall or double-sided central


- Best For: Steel pipes, extruded aluminium, timber, PVC conduit, coils


Request Specification Sheet → 








SYSTEM 07 // FIFO DYNAMIC FLOW 

## Pallet & Carton Flow Racking

Gravity-fed dynamic roller lanes automatically advance pallets and cartons toward the picking face. Physically isolates replenishment loading from front-end order fulfillment.



- Stock Rotation: Strict First-In, First-Out (FIFO)


- Safety: Speed controller brake rollers & end-stop separators


- Best For: Perishable goods, pharmaceutical expiry batches, high-speed picking


Request Specification Sheet → 








SYSTEM 08 // STRUCTURAL EXPANSION 

## Mezzanine Floors & Platforms

Double or triple your usable warehouse square footage without expanding the building envelope. Custom structural steel or rack-supported mezzanine designs engineered in Tekla/RSTAB.



- Floor Loading: 350 kg/m² to 2,000+ kg/m²


- Options: Heavy-duty grating, chequered plate, or particle board


- Best For: Sorting hubs, office-over-storage, assembly lines, buffer staging


Request Specification Sheet →

Additional configurations / Approved product offerings

## Find the right fit.


Double-deep & mobile pallet racking
Double-deep racking uses two rack bays to increase the rack-to-aisle ratio for higher storage density. Mobile pallet racks move laterally to create access aisles when required, helping maximise capacity while retaining SKU selectivity.


Heavy-duty, bolt-free & flow shelving
Heavy-duty shelving serves medium-to-heavy goods and mixed palletised and non-palletised storage. Bolt-free shelving supports flexible light-duty and spare-parts storage. Carton and bin flow racking uses gravity for efficient picking and FIFO operations.



Talk to an expert ↗ 





ENGINEERING FAQs & SPECIFICATIONS 

## Frequently Asked Engineering Questions




What factors determine the right warehouse racking system for a facility?


Selecting the optimal storage system depends on five core parameters: (1) Inventory Profile: pallet dimensions, weights, and SKU diversity; (2) Throughput Velocity: picking frequencies and FIFO vs. LIFO rotation rules; (3) Handling Equipment: mast lift heights and forklift turning radius; (4) Building Envelope: clear floor height, column grid spacing, and slab load capacity; and (5) Future Scalability: planned expansion phases and potential automated shuttle/ASRS integration.






How does ProRack ensure structural safety and seismic compliance?


ProRack models every installation using 3D structural analysis tools (Tekla Structures and RSTAB), accounting for dynamic forklift impact loads, dead loads, and regional seismic zone coefficients in accordance with IS 1893, EN 15512, and FEM 10.2.02. In addition, ProRack is planning collaboration with IIT-Powai to validate and certify structural designs and site installations.






Can existing racking layouts be upgraded or reconfigured?


Yes. ProRack's selective and multi-bay upright patterns are designed for modular adjustment, allowing beam levels to be repositioned on standard 50mm or 75mm pitch increments. Our SmartFit installation team also conducts structural health audits to verify load charts and install safety upgrades such as column protectors, rack end barriers, and mesh decking.

# Warehouse Engineering & Structural BIM | ProRack AI

INTEGRATED PROJECT DELIVERY 

## 
From Warehouse Plan
To Certified Operating System. 



One continuous, closed-loop engineering process keeps design intent, structural calculations, cold roll-forming manufacturing, and site handover strictly aligned with international codes and digital transparency.



Explore 5 Delivery Stages ↓ 
Consult an Engineer 









DISCIPLINED EXECUTION GATES 

## The Five Delivery Stages


Each phase enforces explicit quality gates, structural models, and operational milestones to eliminate variance between commercial commitments and physical site reality.













MODEL-DRIVEN FABRICATION 

## 
Tekla 3D & RSTAB Finite Element Calculations



Every ProRack installation begins as a comprehensive 3D BIM model. We do not rely on generic estimations; our structural engineers simulate actual load distributions, baseplate anchor reactions, beam deflections, and seismic response spectra using Dlubal RSTAB and Tekla Open API workflows.




- Clash Elimination: Pre-fabrication clash detection against building PEB columns, downspouts, HVAC ducts, and lighting runs.


- Codes & Tolerances: Strict compliance with EN 15512 (European racking code), RMI (US specification), and IS 800 (Indian standard).


- Direct CNC Integration: Automated cut lists and punching patterns fed directly into roll-forming shop floor lines.


- Academic Validation: Planned institutional certification with IIT-Powai for structural integrity assurance.


Explore ProRack AI Digital Platform → 











OPERATIONAL TRANSPARENCY 

## 
Structured Change Order Management



In complex industrial projects, warehouse floor plans and operational layouts frequently evolve. Uncontrolled changes create site delays, mismatched components, and structural risks. ProRack operates a formalized engineering change order framework:




1. Digital Revision Control 
Every layout revision is version-controlled with automated DWG/IFC diff comparisons, ensuring site teams never install outdated drawings.



2. Tonnage & Coil Reallocation 
Material changes immediately sync with shop floor coil nesting software to prevent scrap and maintain delivery schedules.



3. Complete Commercial Clarity 
Clients receive clear, itemized impact summaries covering cost variations, structural implications, and handover dates prior to execution.










ENGINEERING FAQs 

## Common Technical Questions




What structural calculations are conducted before manufacturing begins?


ProRack performs full global and local finite element structural analysis: upright buckling capacity, beam end connector shear and moment rotation, baseplate bearing stresses on the concrete slab, anchorage pull-out resistance, and dynamic seismic drift under IS 1893 and EN 15512 specifications.






How does ProRack ensure material traceability on the production line?


Every coil of high-tensile steel is logged with mill heat test certificates (MTC), yield strength verification, and coil heat tracking. Components are barcoded through roll-forming, punching, welding, and powder coating, giving clients verifiable traceability for quality audits.

THE PRORACK ADVANTAGE 

## 
Coordinating Work Between Trades



Traditional warehouse setups require the client to coordinate separate racking vendors, MEP contractors, civil crews, and installation teams. When piping obstructs pallet beams or when floor anchors damage post-tensioned slabs, delays mount. ProRack solves this through:




Single Point Responsibility 
One accountable contract managing structural design, installation safety, and MEP infrastructure synchronization.



BIM Space Reservation 
In-rack fire sprinklers and lighting trunking are modeled in Tekla 3D files so clashes can be identified and resolved before installation.



Rapid Turnaround Delivery 
Manufacturing runs alongside site preparation, so completed areas can be handed over in phases where the project allows.

## Company questions

Who owns and runs ProRack AI?
ProRack AI is the brand of ProRack Storage Solutions India Private Limited, a member company of the ProRack AI Group. The company is led by Managing Director Roshan Sudhir, with Niket Sherlekar as Group Chief Operating Officer, Girish Annath as Director, Kshitij Salve as VP, Sales and Marketing, and Prajakta Roshan as Administration Head.


What is the relationship between ProRack and Silver Lining Storage Solutions?
ProRack Storage Solutions builds on the legacy of Silver Lining Storage Solutions, the warehouse storage business of Mangal Industries, part of the Amara Raja Group.


Where is ProRack Storage Solutions registered?
The registered office is H.No.10-2-294/Plot No.177, Flat No.303, 3rd Floor, Royal Sai Mahalaxmi Pride, West Marredpally, Secunderabad 500026, Telangana, India. The company serves warehousing and manufacturing hubs across India and supports Middle East export projects.


Which ProRack businesses deliver warehouse projects?
ProRack Storage Solutions designs and manufactures racking, shelving, mezzanines and rack-clad structures. SmartFit Solutions handles surveying and site installation, and ProMec Integration covers fire safety, HVAC, electrical and material-handling infrastructure.

## Air-Gapped OT Network Protection


ProRack AI edge relays run on isolated plant networks with outbound-only TLS 1.3 connectivity. No external inbound connections are permitted to factory PLC controllers or machine safety networks.

# Enterprise Architecture & Governance | ProRack AI
URL: https://prorack.ai/architecture.html
Summary: ProRack AI Enterprise Architecture: Non-disruptive integration, source-level RBAC, immutable audit logging, human write boundaries, and on-premises OT edge security.

DATA PLATFORM & GOVERNANCE 

## Access Controls and Audit Records.
Platform concept / interactive demonstrations use sample data. No live customer or machine connection.


An ingestion-to-application pipeline engineered specifically for industrial engineering workflows, with strict role-based access control, cryptographic auditability, and human write boundaries.










THE 4-STAGE PIPELINE 

## End-to-End Execution Flow


Every user request flows through a deterministic interpretation and policy validation layer before accessing any connected enterprise system.







OPERATIONS 

## Users & Team

Plant managers, structural engineers, QC chiefs



→ 


LAYER 01 

## ProRack AI Core

Context synthesis & semantic cross-referencing



→ 


LAYER 02 

## Controlled Tool Layer

RBAC permissions, audit logging, human sign-off



→ 


SOURCE SYSTEMS 

## Enterprise & Factory

ERPNext · Tekla · PowerFab · PLCs · WMS






Core Architectural Principle: ProRack AI does not replace your source systems of record; it connects, interprets, and surfaces operational intelligence across them. Your ERP, CAD/BIM models, and factory PLCs continue operating as the authoritative sources of truth.










SECURITY & COMPLIANCE 

## Six Pillars of Enterprise Governance


The proposed architecture checks user permissions, records access and requires approval for changes to connected systems.






01 // ACCESS CONTROL 

## Source-Level RBAC


ProRack AI inherits permission scopes directly from ERPNext and Microsoft 365. An employee without commercial margin visibility cannot query cost data through the AI assistant.





02 // AUDIT COMPLIANCE 

## Immutable Audit Trails


Every query, telemetry extraction, and user action is cryptographically logged with user identity, timestamp, and source system citations to support audit reviews.





03 // HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP 

## Controlled Write Boundary


The AI layer is read-only by default. Any operational write-action (e.g. releasing a hold on a work order) strictly requires explicit authorized human confirmation.





04 // GROUNDED INTELLIGENCE 

## Deterministic Citations


Operational inquiries are answered strictly with verifiable citations to underlying structural models, ERP documents, and machine PLCs. Speculative answers are explicitly blocked.





05 // NETWORK SECURITY 

## On-Premises Edge Relays


Lightweight edge agents interface with machine PLCs using outbound-only TLS 1.3 connections, preventing inbound exposure of factory OT networks to the public internet.





06 // DATA PRIVACY 

## Complete Sovereignty


Structural CAD files, proprietary roll-forming die profiles, customer layouts, and cost metrics remain isolated in your private environment and are never used for public model training.












HARDENED OT INFRASTRUCTURE 

## On-Premises Edge Relay Architecture.


To protect mission-critical cold roll-forming lines and punch presses, ProRack AI operates hardened edge compute nodes deployed inside factory OT environments with outbound-only TLS 1.3 telemetry encryption.




- ✓ Industrial DIN-rail IPC running isolated deterministic telemetry collectors


- ✓ Modbus TCP and OPC-UA isolation preventing inbound external connections


- ✓ 50 ms local buffering designed to retain telemetry during network drops






FACTORY OT NODE // SECURE RACK 01 
OUTBOUND TLS 1.3 ACTIVE

LAB VALIDATION PILOT 

## Optical Computer Vision Quality Control.


Planned for the Hyderabad facility: multi-camera optical arrays positioned along the roll-former outfeed would inspect punch hole alignment, slot pitch variance, and weld bead continuity. Line-speed targets remain subject to development and validation.




- ✓ Sub-millimeter laser profile scanning for structural column uprights


- ✓ Early flagging of die wear drift (target) before punch tolerance is exceeded


- ✓ Automated digital twin tag generation linked directly to ERP cut lists
